6 of 8 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review

The committee discussed the Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review, a review of the company's compliance with labor laws. The committee reviewed the company's employment practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To approve for brand equity: RESOLVED, that the Government Affairs Committee tables the motion regarding the Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review until such time as the requested supplementary data can be provided and reviewed.

Moved: Richard Hayashi  •  Seconded: Robert Cochran
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Incentive Compensation Governance Report

The Incentive Compensation Governance Report was a review of the company's supply chain performance. Robert Cochran reported that on-time delivery rates had improved to 10%, a 139-point increase from the previous quarter.

Item 3
Incentive Plan Design Modifications — FY 2009 Proposal

The committee discussed the Incentive Plan Design Modifications — FY 2009 Proposal, a review of the company's intellectual property strategy. The committee approved a budget to file 139 new patents in the coming year.

Motion

To concur: RESOLVED, that the Government Affairs Committee recommends the appointment of Argent Benefits Group as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending 2009-11-27.

Moved: Robert Cochran  •  Seconded: Jerry Persson
Vote: 4 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
